dedupe_keys.name: argentina power plants centrales de generacion layer with the national dams and hydropower inventory

description: The Secretaría de Energía of Argentina publishes a monthly updated layer of the country's electricity generating plants on its energy open data portal. Contents: Generación Eléctrica - Centrales de generación locates the power plants of the national system with their attributes (plant, technology and related fields as released in the files); the related Centrales Eléctricas and nuclear plant datasets (Atucha and Embalse, from the Comisión Nacional de Energía Atómica) and the Inventario de Presas y Centrales Hidroeléctricas de la República Argentina, a four-volume PDF inventory of dams and hydropower plants prepared by the Subsecretaría de Recursos Hídricos, complete the picture. Coverage: national; the plant layer was last updated on 22 September 2026 and is scheduled monthly; the dams inventory was posted on 27 September 2024. Format and access: Shapefile and CSV for the plant layer and PDF for the dams inventory, from the CKAN portal datos.energia.gob.ar. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the plant attributes were not read field by field here, and the dams inventory is a document, not a table, so dam data must be extracted by hand. Simulation uses: generation assets for power system capacity planning, hazard exposure of plants and dams, and network models. Related records: the transmission and distribution networks of the same portal (data-argentina-electricity-transmission-distribution-networks) and CAMMESA's wholesale market data on the same portal.
